The Full Moon in Scorpio on April 23rd, 2024, illuminates the depths of our inner world, revealing the mysteries that lie within. As the Moon "dances" with the Sun, it awakens our primal instincts, stirring the passions and desires that have been dormant. "The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall" - Nelson Mandela - as we confront our shadow selves and the secrets we've kept hidden.

This Full Moon "unleashes" the intensity of Scorpio, a sign of rebirth and transformation. It's a call to confront the darkness within, to face our fears and insecurities, and to emerge stronger and wiser. "The darkest hour is just before the dawn" - Thomas Edison - as we navigate the unknown, and the light of the Full Moon guides us through the darkness.
